setup.title: How to get a client ID and secret
setup.intro: A free Google account is enough — you do not need Workspace, and you do not need a domain for your panel. Five steps, once.

step1.title: Create a Google Cloud project
step1.body: Sign in and create a project. Call it anything. It is free and needs no card.

step2.title: Enable the Google Drive API
step2.body: Search for the Google Drive API in the library and enable it. Skipping this is the most common mistake: sign-in still works, and every upload fails afterwards.

step3.title: Set up the consent screen
step3.body: Choose External, then fill in an app name and your own email address.
step3.publish: Publish the app. If you leave it in Testing, Google expires access after about seven days and your backups stop — they will work all week and fail the next, with nothing in the panel having changed. You do not need Google to verify it; one warning screen for your own app is expected.

step4.title: Create the OAuth client
step4.body: Create credentials, choose OAuth client ID, and pick application type Web application. Add the address below under Authorized redirect URIs — Google compares it exactly, so copy it.

step5.title: Paste them below and connect
step5.body: Copy the client ID and client secret into the fields below and save. Then press Connect on the destination to approve access — the panel creates its own folder in your Drive, so there is no folder ID to find.
